mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises > 1% in 1 month and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 jobs in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) simultaneously decreases by more than 0.2%, it signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS > 200k & UNRATE decreases > 0.2% and 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising housing starts (HOUST) and increasing real GDP (GDPC1) signals strong economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST & GDPC1 both increase and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a period of supply-side constraints, a decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals weakening supply-side fundamentals, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases > 2% YoY and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances.
